requirements_summary: Workload: RAG enterprise search with embeddings + reranking. Indexing scale: phase 1 = 10M-50M docs; target = 200M-500M. Latency targets: p50 <60ms, p95 <160ms, p99 <250ms (EU users); reranker end-to-end budget target <= $0.002/query for 1k sustained qps (stretch: cost at 10k qps). Query profile: 70% short queries, 30% long context. QPS: baseline 300 qps, expected peak 4k qps. Language coverage: 35 languages including EN, DE, FR, ES, IT, PT, JP, KO, ZH, AR, HI, PL, NL, SV, FI. Per-language tuning: need per-language recall/precision tracking, separate reranker weights, and eval suite per language (precision@k, MRR, nDCG). Model prefs: prefer multilingual embedding model (1536 dim) for storage efficiency, cross-encoder (BERT-large / fine-tuned) for rerank on high-value queries. Deployment: VPC/Dedicated for reranker, hosted for low-cost retrieval. Data residency: DE for sensitive content; option to air-gap subset if required. Integration: support incremental/real-time indexing, TTL for ephemeral docs, bulk reindex APIs.
